name: Ecological Pyramid of Trophic Levels & 10% Energy Flow
semanticDescription: 4-tier 3D ecological stepped pyramid representing Producers (10,000 J), Herbivores (1,000 J), Carnivores (100 J), and Top Predators (10 J) demonstrating Lindeman's 10% energy transfer law and biomagnification gradient (CBSE Class 10 Environment Ch 13 Figure 13.2).
simplifications: Stepped tier format with labeled energy values (10,000 J, 1,000 J, 100 J, 10 J).
Color gradation illustrates energy attenuation from rich green producers to crimson apex predators.

materials.look: Lush vibrant emerald green base tier (Producers / 10,000 J)
Warm amber/gold intermediate tier (Primary Consumers / 1,000 J)
Vibrant orange secondary consumer tier (Small Carnivores / 100 J)
Deep crimson red apex tier (Top Predators / 10 J)
Clean luminescent white boundary step edges
